rules.statement: An interlocutory appeal does not ipso facto stay proceedings in the action pending the determination of the appeal.
rules.supporting_quote: "On the contrary, to judge from the provisions of chapter LIX. regarding the somewhat analogous case of an appeal from a decree, it would appear that the Code does not contemplate an appeal acting as a stay of proceedings, and, in my opinion, there is no stay of proceedings on an interlocutory appeal, unless an application is made for the purpose and acceded to."
